attacks.name: Deadly Illusions
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
If this attack would deal 1 or more |!damage|, it deals 1 |!damage| instead.
|*Mind Over Matter|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may remove 2 special conditions from the defender. If it does, the defender suffers 2 |!damage|.

|!wild| |*Psychosomatic Effects|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| in the attack roll, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§poison§Poison|, |§shock§Shock| or |§incinerate§Incinerate|.

attacks.name: Mass Hallucinations
steps: |!wild| |*Puppeteer|: After each attack is resolved, this character may Advance the defender |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: Your Reality is Whatever I Want it to Be
superPowers.body: This character may spend any amount of |!power| to use this superpower. Choose an enemy character within |!range| 5 of this character with a |!mystic| Defense equal to or less than the amount of |!power| spent to use this superpower. Then this character may make an attack targeting a different enemy character with a |!range|, |!strength|, and type equal to 1 of the chosen character's attacks with a |!power| cost of 0. |!range| and LOS are measured from the chosen enemy character instead of |*Lady Mastermind| during this attack. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Brain Fog
superPowers.body: During this character's Activation, enemy characters cannot use |!reactive| superpowers or Reactive Team Tactic Cards.

superPowers.name: Mental Lock
superPowers.body: When an enemy character targets this character with an attack, it may use its |!mystic| Defense regardless of the attack's type unless the attacking character pays 2 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Try a Little Harder Next Time
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character rolls 1 or more |!failure| in any roll, after the effect is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
